text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
There is the tanuki again.
I have not forgotten the ordeal he put Miss Karyl through last time...
Such cruelty deserves punishment!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの化けダヌキです……
前回はよくも
キャル様にあんなひどい仕打ちを……
悪い子はお仕置きです！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah, you got that right.
Let's take revenge for my stinging cheeks!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
ええ、
そうね。
あたしの頬っぺたの仇をとるわよ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Hang on... Wasn't it Koro who actually did all that...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ……
具体的にひどいのはコロ助だったんじゃ……
